title: Register 'rocket init' command in Commander
description: Add the 'init' subcommand to the Commander program. This command initializes the .agent/ directory structure in an existing project. No flags needed for v1.
acceptanceCriteria: Command description is 'Initialize .agent/ structure in an existing project'
Command is wired to src/commands/init.ts handler

steps.details: Create src/commands/init.ts exporting: `export async function initCommand(): Promise<void> { console.log('init command') }`

steps.description: Register the init command in src/cli.ts
steps.details: Add to program: `program.command('init').description('Initialize .agent/ structure in an existing project').action(initCommand)`. Import initCommand at the top of src/cli.ts.
Run `npm run dev -- init --help`. Should print the description 'Initialize .agent/ structure in an existing project'.
